attributes.provenance: work_claim.cameradata-sweep.20260831.v1 (worktree GDL-Claude-CamData): 21 isolated A/B probes via tools/gdl/probe.py across combat.c (14 functions), camera.c (5) and bosscam.c (2), each substitution reverted with probe.py --revert unless it measured IMPROVED. Literal values were recomputed from the raw bytes tools/gdl/poolval.py prints and verified to re-encode bit-identically (struct.pack round-trip) before use.

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: Boundary refinement of claim.law.extern-scalar-read-defeats-fp-literal-hoist. Replacing a reconstruction's `extern f32/f64 lbl_*` pool reads with the literal value is a per-FUNCTION and per-CONSTANT bet whose sign varies inside a single TU, not a TU-wide or project-wide fix; it must be A/B'd one constant-group at a time with an automatic revert on anything short of IMPROVED. Measured across three GDL camera TUs: in combat.c it won five times (get_cam_wpos real 493->454, CameraSupervisor 527->426, StandardCamera 723->695, get_attn_pos 162->146, DiffRate 127->126) and lost or did nothing in nine other functions; the SAME f32 0.0f sentinel (lbl_80345EC8) IMPROVED CameraSupervisor by 71 real lines yet REGRESSED InitCamera (995->1008), get_cam_wpos and cam_orient_to (4->22) in the same file, and regressed camera.c catastrophically and repeatably (camera_mode_dest 166->457, camera_mode_follow 386->827, camera_mode_level 62->294) -- consistent with claim.law.explicit-fp-symbol-vs-literal-zero-regression's warning that a literal and an identically-valued extern are genuinely different source forms. Three operational rules fall out. (1) PREDICTOR: the substitution can only pay where the function still has an instruction-count gap for a hoist to close. Every camera.c function probed already had an EXACT instruction count (444/444, 682/682, 1048/1048, 582/582, 1006/1008) -- a pure register/schedule residual with no missing prologue hoist -- and every one was neutral or worse; the combat.c winners all had count or operand gaps. Check `fndiff --count` before spending probes. (2) SECTION DISCIPLINE, and this is a semantic-correctness rule not a scoring one: only `.sdata2`/`.rodata` labels are the read-only literal pool. `.sdata` labels look identical in source (`extern f32 lbl_80343B88;`) but are WRITABLE small data holding genuinely mutable globals -- bosscam.c declares 13 float externs of which 11 are .sdata -- and literalizing one would be a real bug, not a match regression. Filter by section from the DOL, never by name shape. (3) ADDRESS-TAKEN EXCLUSION: a pool label read through `*(volatile f32*)&lbl_x` (an existing matching idiom, e.g. combat.c screen_limitation) cannot be literalized at all -- `&0.0f` is not valid C and the substitution breaks the build rather than scoring badly, so any automated sweep must skip `&`-prefixed occurrences and lvalue positions. Finally, verify the literal before trusting it: poolval.py's printed f32/f64 lines are ROUNDED, so recompute the shortest-roundtrip decimal from the raw bytes and assert it re-encodes to the same bits. In this corpus the PI-family constants really are 10-digit decimals (3.141592654, 6.283185308, 1.570796327), NOT M_PI -- substituting a full-precision constant would have changed both the bits and the semantics.
